# Malay Mishra — Portfolio

> Personal portfolio site of Malay Mishra, a senior frontend engineer transitioning to fullstack. Live at https://malaymishra.com.

The site is a single-page Next.js app with a WebGL particle scene that morphs between figures as you scroll. Sections: hero, about, work, skills, impact, focus, and contact. Experience and skills data is fetched at build/runtime from a public GitHub data repo and revalidated hourly.

## About
- Name: Malay Mishra
- Role: Senior Frontend Engineer (transitioning to fullstack)
- Currently at: Adeptmind
- Stack focus: React, Next.js, TypeScript, GSAP, Tailwind CSS, Go, Python

## Pages
- [Home](https://malaymishra.com/): main landing page with all sections
- [Hero](https://malaymishra.com/#hero): intro
- [About](https://malaymishra.com/#about): positioning statement
- [Work](https://malaymishra.com/#work): work history
- [Skills](https://malaymishra.com/#skills): tech stack
- [Impact](https://malaymishra.com/#impact): quantified engineering outcomes
- [Focus](https://malaymishra.com/#focus): skills grouped by domain
- [Contact](https://malaymishra.com/#contact): contact links

Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Three.js (WebGL GPGPU particle system), GSAP + ScrollTrigger + ScrollSmoother + SplitText.
